scope: Pass 3 (owner request 2026-09-29): during transitions between states, add very minor GIF-style glitch accents: only a few small glitch boxes (horizontal RGB scanline smears, colour-split edges, mosaic gaps) on the particle form, briefly.

inputs.summary: 3-moment strip: particle eye dissolving with 2-4 small glitch boxes each; inputs p1 img-07 and week3/pivot_references/0268915e2cc8124b9d5b9c99545f8736.gif (public repo raw URL)
first frame p1 img-07; eye dissolves while 2-3 small glitch boxes flicker briefly

inspection.method: full-size image review; video sampled as 24 frames (not watched in real time)
observations: img-01: 2-4 small boxes per moment; horizontal scanline stripes in cyan/magenta/lime/white, colour-split edges, thin sideways trail lines past box edges, a few mosaic cells; boxes sit on the form and never obscure the pupil region's identity; count drops as the form dissolves.

vid-01 (5.04 s): about four glitch events over ~3 s, mostly one at a time, each ~0.2-0.6 s: a thin vertical line opens into a small dark-backed box of vertical colour stripes with an outline, a thin horizontal trail line crosses the eye, then it vanishes. The model did not dissolve the eye (it only brightened), so only the glitch timing and box grammar were used.
limitations: Video frames sampled, not watched in real time.

img-01 shows horizontal scanlines; the video shows vertical stripes. The implementation follows the video's box (vertical stripes, dark backing) because the first horizontal-row attempt (p3-a1) was nearly invisible over bright particles.

implementationGuidance: Glitches only while the eye changes: expressive energy rising/falling or a composition handover; none when settled, in reduced motion, or when the clock is frozen (End).
At most 3 at once; ~3-4 per transition in the real runtime.
Each event 0.2-0.48 s: line -> striped box -> trail -> fade, anchored on moving eye landmarks.
Small: box width 0.12-0.22 of the eye display scale.
